description: Full-text search over the Serverdex directory of MCP servers (names, titles, descriptions). Returns compact rows: slug, name, author, description, category, GitHub stars, links. Use get_server with a slug for install configs.

category.description: Restrict to one category slug (see list_categories).

query.description: Words to search for, e.g. 'postgres', 'calendar', 'web scraping'. Omit to browse.

sort.description: new = newest first (default), name = A–Z, stars = most GitHub stars first.

name: search_servers
title: Search MCP servers
